title: Original - 3 Layered BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress - Grey
description:
Enhanced comfort and support: Smartly contours to mirror every body shape, weight, and sleep position.

Personalized comfort with BodyIQ Technology: Adapts intelligently to each body position, providing tailored support throughout the night.

Ideal ratio of softness, firmness, and support: Suitable for every body shape and lifestyle.

Pressure relief and spinal alignment: Alleviates pressure points and promotes ideal spinal alignment.

Zero partner disturbance: Ensures peaceful sleep by minimizing disturbance from partner movements.
